subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, replace it with a same-repository OpenClaw PR, or ask the contributor to refresh the fork PR?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and the fix shape is narrow, but an open external fork PR already owns the candidate patch, so automation should not create a duplicate without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or Adopt Fork PR
options.body: Review the external candidate and adopt it into the target repository if it still fits current main.

options.title: Replace Upstream
options.body: Open a narrow same-repository PR applying the same central label normalization and regression coverage.

options.title: Wait for Refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the external contributor to refresh the candidate before adoption.

recommendation.title: Review or Adopt Fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the external candidate and adopt it into the target repository if it still fits current main.
